_comment: REFERENCE DATA — publicly-documented STATE-CONTROLLED or STATE-AFFILIATED MEDIA domains. ORGANIZATIONS ONLY, never persons. TruthLens bakes in no political judgments: every entry cites an auditable public source (here, official EU Council / EEAS designations). Matching a domain here is a CORRELATION lead for a human analyst — NEVER proof that any specific post is state-directed. Expand only from auditable public sources via scripts/refresh-state-media.ts; see data/io-reference/README.md.

schema.domain: registrable domain, lowercase, no scheme/www (e.g. example.com)
schema.label: organization label as publicly documented (org, not a person)
schema.source: public provenance URL for this classification
